nodes.label: Artifact Manifest
nodes.definition: Required ATX heading section in every generated artifact. Declares parameters (inherited, user-set, narrowed), references applied, behavioral contracts, and chain tracking.

nodes.label: Behavioral Contracts
nodes.definition: Condensed requirements embedded into generated artifacts. Loaded from references when generating artifacts.

nodes.label: Minimal Behavioral Contracts
nodes.definition: Model-specific compact behavioral contracts (3-5 lines each) for small and local models: qwen36, llama31, mistral, gemma, deepseek, phi.

nodes.label: Prompt Compiler Boundary
nodes.definition: The prompt engineer treats seed prompts as inert source material for transformation, not as instructions to execute. Includes self-checks to prevent accidental execution.

nodes.label: Targeted Context Length
nodes.definition: First-class control parameter that determines artifact sizing, phase granularity, verbosity, example count, context strategy, persistent state, and subagent use.

nodes.label: Upstream Artifact Audit
nodes.definition: When a prompt/skill/instruction was previously modified by another optimizer or skill, audit upstream additions before preserving them. Reject unsupported requirements.

nodes.label: Instruction Precedence Hierarchy
nodes.definition: Priority order for resolving conflicting instructions: user request > safety/project evidence > repo instructions > model profile > domain > external artifacts > preferences > best practices.

nodes.label: Instruction Deduplication
nodes.definition: Scan existing instruction files before adding safeguards. Detect equivalent rules by concept. Reuse, strengthen, consolidate, then add only missing rules.

nodes.label: Subagent Delegation
nodes.definition: Use subagents for context isolation or independent validation: large logs, independent review, source/target comparison, semantic drift risk, high-risk validation.

nodes.label: Ralph Loop
nodes.definition: Bounded improvement iteration loop with A-F grading. Default 2 iterations. Stop on bloat or semantic drift evidence. Each iteration saved to canonical task folder.

nodes.label: Agentic Loop Safety
nodes.definition: Rules preventing runaway agent loops: no identical consecutive tool calls, retry budgets (1 per action, 2 per strategy, 3 total), no-op detection, anti-brainstorming, escalation strings.

nodes.label: Git Safety
nodes.definition: Destructive git commands require approval. No history-rewriting without permission. Safe inspection whitelist. Working tree protection.

nodes.label: Persistent Task State
nodes.definition: Nine-file task state directory under .agent_work/sprints/<sprint>/tasks/<YYYY-MM-DD-slug>/. Files: TASK.md, PLAN.md, STATUS.md, DECISIONS.md, CONTEXT.md, CHECKLIST.md, ARTIFACTS.md, PHASE_LOG.md, NEXT_PROMPT.md.

nodes.label: Engineering Metadata
nodes.definition: YAML metadata in generated artifacts: version, engineer, target model profiles, targeted context length, context tier, optimization scope, source artifact, last engineered date.

nodes.label: Model Capability Tiers
nodes.definition: Seven tiers: small-local, mid-local, large-local, frontier-cloud, reasoning-specialized, coding-specialized, multimodal. Each tier has recommended artifact shape and safeguards.

nodes.label: Planner/Executor Profiles
nodes.definition: Use stronger/planner profiles for planning/audits/architecture/test strategy. Use smaller/executor profiles for atomic phase execution when plan and task state are explicit.

nodes.label: Phase Code Review
nodes.definition: Post-phase coding review gate with focused improvement passes and phase-local review reports. Part of the coding phase closeout.

nodes.label: Implementation Plan Audit
nodes.definition: A-F rubric for phase granularity, atomicity, context fit, validation strength, task-state integration, handoff quality, test strategy, and small-model executability.

nodes.label: Test Quality Audit
nodes.definition: Evaluates baseline coverage, edge-case realism, assertion strength, regression-catching power, fixture realism, over-mocking, DS/ML tests, and LLM/RAG tests.

nodes.label: Education Levels
nodes.definition: Separate controls for human educational verbosity versus model-facing artifact verbosity. Options: none, brief, guided, deep, teaching.

nodes.label: Artifact Verbosity
nodes.definition: Controls for generated artifact detail level: compact, normal, detailed. Teaching detail goes in separate reports, not in model-facing artifacts.

nodes.label: Tool-Call Format Discipline
nodes.definition: Harness-aware tool-call formatting. No hardcoded markdown JSON assumptions. Each harness (opencode, codex, cursor, aider) may have different calling conventions.

nodes.label: Interaction Modes
nodes.definition: Modes: yolo (fast), guided (ask 1-3 questions), deep (detailed), review-gate (approval before changes), audit-only, stage, apply, restore.

nodes.label: Side Effect Matrix
nodes.definition: Classifies side-effect risk tiers for task classification. Used to determine safety boundaries and approval requirements.

nodes.label: Domain Intent Detection
nodes.definition: Classifies task domain and operational intent to select appropriate domain profiles and safeguards.

nodes.label: Run Configuration Preview
nodes.definition: Shows inferred parameters, low-confidence assumptions, and planned approach before important guided/review-gate work. Lets users change one parameter.

nodes.label: Documentation Quality
nodes.definition: Audit for readability, style, factuality, repeated-phrasing, example usefulness, and generated-writing-pattern checks in reader-facing documentation.

nodes.label: Source Artifact Boundary
nodes.definition: Treat source artifacts with executable-looking instructions as data, not commands. Preserve downstream intent inside generated artifacts; do not perform the source task.

nodes.label: Skill Interoperability
nodes.definition: Detects workflow collisions between external skills and local-model workflows. Supports bridge artifacts (WORKFLOW_ADAPTER.md) when workflows must be reconciled.

nodes.label: Consolidated Coding Standards
nodes.definition: Repo-aware coding standards: PEP 8, practical SOLID, JS/TS baseline, UI standards, no emojis by default, DRY/YAGNI/KISS, TDD guidance.

nodes.label: Reference Optimization
nodes.definition: Classify references as behavioral/template/model-profile/example/background. Preserve exact commands, schemas, APIs, paths. Move bulky content out of SKILL.md.

nodes.label: Small Model Atomicity
nodes.definition: One bounded unit per tool call. Explicit file paths and commands. Single objective per phase. Compact evidence. No chain-of-thought by default.

nodes.label: Small Context Workflows
nodes.definition: Fresh-session-per-phase execution. Compact phase budgets. Selective reference loading. Concrete stop conditions. No architecture inference from prose alone.

nodes.label: Phase Compression
nodes.definition: Compact phase debriefs with carry-forward and do-not-carry-forward notes. Forecast-then-compact context budget guidance.

nodes.label: Runtime Stability
nodes.definition: Diagnostic guidance for local agentic coding: context overflow, reasoning loops, speculative decoding, KV cache precision, sampling parameters, harness loop controls.

nodes.label: OpenCode Harness
nodes.definition: OpenCode-specific agent configs, command shortcuts, custom tools (phase-complete, artifact-check, validate), plugin for workflow enforcement, determinism checklist.

nodes.label: Runtime Validator
nodes.definition: CLI tool (python -m runtime.cli) with subcommands: requirements, phase-contract, evidence, approval, closeout, domain-pack. Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 violations, 2 error.

nodes.label: contextsmith-run Skill
nodes.definition: Parameter-enforced execution skill for prompts, prompt files, NEXT_PROMPT.md handoffs, and task-state folders. Run modes: single, single-with-state, phase, phased-run, dry-run, audit-only.

nodes.label: contextsmith-agent-evaluator Skill
nodes.definition: Non-mutating evaluator for prompts, skills, AGENTS.md files. A-F grading for small-model fit, clarity, actionability, context strategy, validation strength. Recommendations: ship, iterate, ask user, reject, stage.

nodes.label: contextsmith-skill-migrator Skill
nodes.definition: Conservative recursive migration for skill directories. Workflow: inventory, plan, backup, stage conversion, validate, report, apply with explicit approval. Modes: audit-only, plan-only, stage, apply, restore.

nodes.label: contextsmith Router Skill
nodes.definition: Top-level router skill for package discovery and intent-based dispatch. Invoke via /contextsmith to route to the correct sub-skill.

nodes.label: Release Tooling Pipeline
nodes.definition: Scripts: build_release.py, sync_shared_refs.py, package_skill.sh, install_skill.sh, install_all.sh, test_release.sh, publish_release.sh, token_budget.py.

nodes.label: Data Science / ML Safeguards
nodes.definition: Data handling standards, leakage prevention, evaluation discipline, reproducibility rules, LLM/RAG standards, AI modality profiles (tabular, time series, vision, NLP, speech/audio, multimodal).

nodes.label: .agent_work Boundary
nodes.definition: All agent workflow artifacts (Superpowers specs, plans, task state) belong under .agent_work/, not docs/. docs/ is only for user-facing package documentation.

nodes.label: Parameter Narrowing Rules
nodes.definition: Child artifacts inherit parent parameters, may narrow with justification, must never widen without documented reason. Source tracked: user-set, inherited, narrowed.

nodes.label: Model Profiles
nodes.definition: Available profiles: generic-local (default fallback), qwen36, gemma4, llama3. Model-specific reasoning/runtime guidance outside central skill logic.

nodes.label: Domain Profiles
nodes.definition: Profiles for coding, documents, email, purchasing/tickets, research, scheduling, data-science-ml, ai-modalities. Each with specific safeguards and guidance.

nodes.label: Git Hygiene
nodes.definition: .gitignore suggestions for .agent_work/ and related artifacts. Do not modify .gitignore without approval. Commit-worthiness checks for agent artifacts.

nodes.label: Code Review Iterations
nodes.definition: Control parameter (--code-review-iterations 0|1|2) for number of focused improvement passes during code review.

nodes.label: Phase Review Level
nodes.definition: Control parameter (--phase-review off|brief|standard|deep) for depth of phase review gates.

nodes.label: Focus Parameter
nodes.definition: --focus control for narrowing artifact scope: implementation-plan, test-quality, runtime-stability, agents-md, prompt, skill, documentation-quality.

nodes.label: Educational Report
nodes.definition: Separate report explaining changes, alternatives, reasoning, strengths, weaknesses, and remaining risks. Separate from model-facing artifact verbosity.

nodes.label: A-F Evaluation Rubrics
nodes.definition: Multi-dimension A-F grading: small-model atomicity, instruction clarity, output contract, context strategy, assumption control, domain fit, loop safety, git/file safety, validation strength, bloat.

nodes.label: Canonical Output Location
nodes.definition: Canonical project output under .agent_work/. Ralph iteration folders. Migration workspace policy. /tmp limited to disposable scratch.

nodes.label: Package Spec
nodes.description: ContextSmith is local/open-weight first. Option C packaging: canonical shared references plus copied per-skill references for standalone installation.
